items.text: Bills ruled out DT Ed Oliver (knee) and WR Josh Palmer (shoulder). WR DJ Moore is questionable (shoulder) but expected to play; CB Christian Benford is back.
Rams' final report: only S Quentin Lake questionable ('trending in the right direction'). Aaron Donald, Colby Parkinson, Jaylen Watson and Davante Adams are good to go.
Line moved from Rams -2.5 / -148 on Oct 7 to Rams -3.5 / -180. Sports Gambling Podcast called it a 'pros vs. joes' game with bigger money on the Rams.
SI: Buffalo's defense ranks 30th in EPA per play allowed; the Rams' defense ranks 3rd.
Dimers' model: Rams 63.8% to win, projected about 28-24 (52 total, under 54.5).

adjust.reason: Bills are without DT Ed Oliver and WR Josh Palmer, and the Rams' injury list cleared. The stats model doesn't price non-QB injuries
